findings.rule: Prove mem[64] >= 128 on every path (it starts at 128 and only grows under the Panic(65) bounds); then 'mem[64] = X; mem[X] = sel' cannot change slot 64, so mem[64] reads as X and the call decodes as address(_27).principalReceivables().

notes: Unoptimized build (solc 0.8.36 noopt). All 58 ABI functions compared; execute (215 lines), the bond-market callback 0x877d8412 and configureDependencies by structure, the rest in full. No semantic error found. Loops: getReserves' for over the clearinghouse registry (2 inlined copies), execute's sum over auctionResults (int256 checked additions) and _getPriceDecimals' 'while (price_ >= 10)' (as 'while t >= 10' with the int8 overflow check) are readable whiles. The other 6 whiles are implicit: the constant-count Permissions/Keycode encodings (2 and 5 iterations, not unrolled), three checked-exponentiation helper loops ('while u > 1'), and the int256[] return-data copy (P7). Immutables read as 0 (artifact): 'static call 0x0.balanceOf(...)' for the OHM/reserve token immutable in 0x4b9de77c. P9: FullMath mulDiv of the scaled capacity and premium expanded.
summary: Faithful on the paths checked with all three source loops readable; the unoptimized build loses call names inside loops to the unresolved free-memory pointer and expands mulDiv.
